name: Protagonist
source:
Born a princess of a neighboring tribe, she was betrothed to Vuong, the Crown Prince of Da Nam. Three years ago, a devastating fire took his life, and she was framed for the tragedy. Branded a murderer, she was exiled to his tomb complex, forced to live in shame.
Now, the court has granted her freedom but at a cruel price: she must marry Vuong’s twin brother, the new Crown Prince. As whispers of supernatural phenomena stir the palace and a group of ambitious young royals arrives with their own agendas, she must navigate a treacherous web of politics, betrayal, and dark secrets to survive.
